originality.rationale: Nearest priors compared substantively, not by timestamp. Mayhew-Royle math/0702316 catalogues all matroids to 9 elements (counts/database) with no Tutte-evaluation table or T(2,0) maximality gap in the simple rank-3 8-element window. Merino et al. 1203.0090 compiles family Tutte formulas and techniques, not a window-complete extremal census or maximizer with gap. Bamiloshin-Farras-Padro 2306.15085 does computer extension-property checks on 8-9 element matroids (new non-linear examples, tic-tac-toe sparse-paving focus) with no T(2,0) census or maximality gap. Brettell 2307.14614 enumerates GF(5) excluded minors on 10 elements (method baseline), no Tutte extremal in this window. Live arXiv exact-phrase search for simple rank-3 8-element T(2,0) maximality returned no results. No source records T_W(2,0)=58, runner-up 56, gap 2, or the complete 68-type T(2,0) table with replay logs; the inequality is not mechanically implied by catalogues or family formulas. Internal SCOPE failures (rank-4 GF5 census, rank-4 paving 9-element census) are different windows/methods/claims.

value.rationale: Strongest self-contained headline (68-type census + uniform maximizer T=58 gap 2 with replay + Fano+free-point member) is an exact invariant of a natural object motivated before computation: simple rank-3 on 8 points is the Blackburn-Crapo-Higgs/Mayhew-Royle benchmark window; T(2,0) is a classical Tutte evaluation tied to pre-registered distinguishing-power and Rota/GGW excluded-minor / Fano-vs-non-Fano questions. Values (58 vs 56, full 13-value spectrum, 433038 labeled families) are not known or mechanically implied -- uniformity does not trivially imply (2,0)-maximality without exhaustion, and the distribution down to 28 is informative. A future researcher testing Tutte distinguishing power, small-field representability, or small-matroid benchmarks could reasonably need this precise fragment and pipeline. This is a meaningful finite exact-invariant census with a proved inequality plus separation, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration. The honestly-qualified window-level (not on-maximizer) Fano separation does not erase the independently valuable exact headline.
